isolation: Each scenario signed in as its own test account (test-employee=Ruwan, test-employee-2=Nadeeka, test-manager=Malith, test-finance-admin=Dilani) and captured that account's own OIDC access token from the webapp's localStorage for direct API calls used in Given setup. Policy-cap scenarios used isolated future calendar months (2027-04 through 2027-07) for each claim's own claimDate, confirmed live via POST /me/claims/policy-check that the monthly cap aggregates by the claim's own month, not wall-clock today — this let each scenario start from a provably empty month instead of fighting years of accumulated shared dev-environment data. Policy-management scenarios read and reset the shared meals-cap policy rule and deleted/recreated the office-supplies rule via direct API immediately before each scenario's Given, then drove the When and asserted the Then through the UI. The cross-team all-claims scenario asserted on two freshly created marker claims identified by distinctive totals (13,371 / 13,372 LKR) rather than on the full claims list, since other runs' data with the same merchant names persists in this shared environment.
